facts.claim: Melenos Art Boutique Hotel sits 'in the heart of an ancient village' of Lindos, 'adjacent to the beckoning Lindos acropolis', and calls a wedding there intimate, for 'an intimate gathering'.

Melenos says it can host a civil matrimony, a symbolic ceremony or a traditional Orthodox wedding, and its wedding coordinator provides a schedule, a costing sheet with deadlines, a budget outline and an itinerary, and meets the couple on arrival.
Melenos suggests reserving the entire hotel for a minimum of three nights; additional guests can stay at Melenos Apartments and Studios in the village, a 10-minute walk away.
Melenos's wedding site names two ceremony locations at the hotel, the Blue Balcony and the Magical Garden, and says the hotel overlooks the sea.

Melenos says its planner handles the legal documentation (filing documents, marriage licence registration, government and administrative fees) and official witnesses can be provided on request; extras it can organise include a rehearsal dinner on the Melenos terrace, a welcome cocktail party, live music, a private boat excursion and donkeys to carry the couple to the location.

Melenos's reception menus are based on traditional Greek cuisine with South Mediterranean influences, with modified menus for dietary needs, and for Orthodox ceremonies it can place Jordan almonds in an antique silver tray on the ceremony table.
Aquagrand's weddings page describes a 5-star, adults-only beachfront wedding venue in Lindos on the shores of Navarone Bay, with dedicated wedding specialists.

Aquagrand says couples can exchange vows on its private beachfront, beneath its Wedding Gazebo, or within landscaped grounds framed by the Aegean, followed by a reception with curated menus and signature cocktails.
Aquagrand publishes two named wedding packages, Aqua Pearl and Aqua Marine.

Aquagrand's Aqua Pearl package lists ceremony locations of the wedding gazebo, the beach, the beach pier, or St Paul's Chapel in Lindos, and its legal section covers the civil registry service, marriage file and certificate, translation of legal documents between English and Greek, and administration fees.
Aquagrand lists extras at a supplement including wedding menus, fireworks, a Greek music group with dancers, a florist and a DJ until 3am or later.
Aquagrand's French package page footer names the property 'Aquagrand Exclusive Deluxe Resort', while its English weddings page calls it 'Aquagrand Artistic Luxury Beach Resort'.
facts.conflicts: Property name differs between the English weddings page and the French package page footer; writer should use the English page name.

facts.claim: Atrium Palace (Atrium Hotels & Resorts, Kalathos beach, Rhodes) has a dedicated weddings page offering private garden ceremonies, beachfront weddings or an intimate gathering at St Paul's Chapel, with wedding menus and spa packages for the couple.

Atrium Palace names Asterias Gardens, palm-lined and in front of Asterias Gourmet restaurant, as a ceremony setting with sea views 'without having to step foot in the sand', and Kalathos private beach within the resort as another.
Atrium Palace says St Paul's Chapel is 6.7 km from the resort, with the secluded Lindos bay as backdrop, and that it needs to be booked as far in advance as possible because of its popularity.
Atrium Palace offers receptions at Mesogeos Pool Restaurant with show cooking and music, and a Premium Collection villa with private pool can be decorated as a bridal villa.
Atrium Palace says its wedding specialist assists couples seeking a civil ceremony with the arrangements to obtain a marriage licence; it also offers symbolic ceremonies, elopements and vow renewals.
Atrium Palace lists services including fireworks, DJ or live music (violin, guitar or bouzouki), bridal hair and make-up, an on-site photographer and a menu tasting with the chef.

Lindos Blu (BLU Collection, Vlicha, Lindos) site navigation lists accommodation, gastronomy, wellness, experience and pool and beach life but no weddings or events page; lindosblu.gr/weddings returned 404. Does not meet the inclusion rule.

insider_details.detail: For a whole-property Lindos wedding, Melenos suggests taking the entire hotel for at least three nights, with overflow guests a 10-minute walk away in the village, so plan the room block and guest walking route together.

St Paul's Chapel appears as an option on two resort wedding pages, and Atrium Palace sits 6.7 km away and advises booking it as early as possible; lock the ceremony site before anything else if it is the dream setting.
For guests who want a sea-view ceremony without sand underfoot, Atrium Palace's Asterias Gardens sits in front of its gourmet restaurant, so ceremony to reception is a short walk.

All three qualifying venues offer help with civil paperwork, but what each covers differs (Aquagrand lists translation and registry services, Melenos fees and witnesses, Atrium Palace licence assistance), so compare scope line by line.
Aquagrand is adults-only, which matters for couples planning to invite children.
